Products.title: Premium Basmati, From Pakistan's Rice Belt
Products.tagline: Rice, sourced and shipped with precision.
Products.subtitle: Sourced from Central Punjab and Sindh, including the Kallar tract long associated with premium Super Basmati cultivation.

portfolio.title: Super Basmati
portfolio.description: Pakistan's flagship export variety — the long, aromatic grain behind roughly 80% of the country's basmati exports to Europe.

portfolio.title: Kernel Basmati
portfolio.description: The second EU-recognised Pakistani basmati variety, eligible for the same preferential import tariff as Super Basmati.

portfolio.title: Sella (Parboiled) Basmati
portfolio.description: Parboiled before milling for a firmer bite and golden colour — the choice of buyers and kitchens who prefer parboiled grain.

portfolio.title: Steam Basmati
portfolio.description: Steam-treated for a cleaner, whiter grain and shorter cooking time — suited to retail buyers who value consistency.

portfolio.title: Brown Basmati
portfolio.description: Milled less to keep the bran layer intact, for health-oriented buyers who want the basmati aroma with more fibre.

portfolio.title: Long-Grain Non-Basmati Rice
portfolio.description: A non-basmati long-grain option for price-sensitive food-service and wholesale demand outside the basmati category.

Quality.title: Compliance-First, By Design
Quality.subtitle: Rice from South Asia sits inside one of the more heavily monitored corners of EU food law. We built our QA programme around exactly what EU border control checks.
Quality.sourcingBody: We source from Pakistan's established rice-growing regions in Central Punjab and Sindh, including the Kallar tract long associated with premium Super Basmati. Pakistan has been the EU's leading basmati supplier for much of 2019–2023, helped by a 2018 EU pesticide-residue rule change that favoured Pakistani basmati's typical compliance profile.
Quality.routeCaption: Karachi to Hamburg via the Suez Canal — the container shipping lane behind every shipment. Approx. 12,000km, 4–5 weeks transit.
Quality.processCaption: How Bawari Group imports basmati rice — Pakistan to Germany. Reference diagram (English).

programme.title: Supplier Qualification
programme.description: Mill and exporter audits, with GLOBALG.A.P./IFS status checked where available.

programme.title: Pre-Shipment Testing
programme.description: Accredited-lab testing against current EU pesticide and mycotoxin limits, before the container leaves Pakistan.

programme.title: Documentation
programme.description: Certificate of Authenticity, phytosanitary certificate, and commercial documents prepared in advance.

programme.title: Border Entry
programme.description: Every consignment pre-notified in the EU's TRACES NT system ahead of arrival at the Border Control Post.

programme.title: Storage
programme.description: Moisture- and pest-controlled warehousing with lot-level traceability coding.

programme.title: Recall Readiness
programme.description: A documented recall and withdrawal procedure, tied to lot codes and tested periodically.

Quality.programmeCaption: The QA programme at a glance. Reference diagram (English).
Quality.complianceNote: EU food-safety regulation is a moving target. We verify current thresholds before every shipment — not a one-time checkbox.

About.title: A Heritage Crest for a Modern Trading House
About.body1: Bawari Group is a Berlin- and Hamburg-based importer and distributor of premium Pakistani rice, built to serve Germany's fast-growing South Asian, Middle Eastern, Central Asian, and mainstream specialty-food consumer base.
About.body2: Our identity is built around a heritage crest — a shield, a bold gold monogram, and a wheat-stalk wreath in charcoal and gold. The wheat motif is a deliberate nod to our roots in the rice trade, tying the mark directly to what we do.
